d: BEST GENSHIN IMPACT SKINS 40 | #genshinimpact #genshin #геншинимпакт #геншин Genshin Impact — это масштабная приключенческая ролевая игра с открытым миром и элементами гача, разработанная китайской студией HoYoverse (ранее известной как miHoYo) и завоевавшая многомиллионную аудиторию по всему миру с момента своего релиза в 2020 году. Действие игры разворачивается в сказочном фэнтезийном мире под названием Тейват, состоящем из семи уникальных королевств, каждое из которых находится под покровительством своего Архонта — божества, олицетворяющего одну из семи стихий: Анемо (ветер), Гео (землю), Электро (электричество), Дендро (природу), Гидро (воду), Пиро (огонь) и Крио (лёд). Завязка сюжета начинается с того, что главный герой, известный как Путешественник или Путешественница, вместе со своим близнецом путешествовал между мирами, но столкнулся с таинственной безымянной богиней, которая разлучила родных людей, лишила их сил и запечатала в Тейвате. Проснувшись спустя сотни лет, главный герой встречает крошечную и жизнерадостную спутницу по имени Паймон, которая становится его гидом, и вместе они отправляются в грандиозное странствие по всем регионам, чтобы вернуть утраченного близнеца и разгадать секреты этого загадочного мира. В процессе своего путешествия игрок посещает невероятно разнообразные земли: свободолюбивый Мондштадт, вдохновлённый средневековой Европой; величественный и контрастный Ли Юэ, созданный на основе древнекитайской культуры и философии; изолированную и суровую островную Инадзуму с эстетикой феодальной Японии; утопающий в джунглях и пустынях Сумеру, впитавший мотивы Южной Азии и Ближнего Востока; прогрессивный и изысканный Фонтейн, выполненный в стиле стимпанка и Прекрасной эпохи Франции, а также другие развивающиеся регионы Тейвата. Повествование отличается огромной глубиной и проработанностью лора, заложенного не только в эпических Заданиях Архонтов и личных историях персонажей, но и в описаниях предметов, прочитанных книгах, древних фресках и руинах, что постепенно открывает перед игроком мрачную историю павшей цивилизации Каэнри'ах и загадочный небесный порядок Селестии. Основой игрового процесса является свобода исследования огромного бесшовного мира и динамичная боевая система, завязанная на элементальном взаимодействии. Игроки могут беспрепятственно перемещаться по живописным локациям, карабкаться по отвесным скалам, парить на планере, плавать, погружаться под воду и решать сотни уникальных головоломок, скрывающих ценные сокровища и тайники. Боевая система строится на создании отряда из четырёх персонажей, между которыми можно мгновенно переключаться прямо во время сражения. Главная фишка боёв — элементальные реакции: наложение одной стихии на другую вызывает мощные визуальные и боевые эффекты, такие как Пар, Таяние, Заморозка, Перегрузка, Раздувание, Кристаллизация, а также сложнейшие Дендро-реакции вроде Бутонизации и Стимуляции. Это побуждает постоянно экспериментировать с составом команды, подбирая героев с синергирующими способностями для эффективного прохождения испытаний, витых бездн и битв с гигантскими боссами. Визуально Genshin Impact выполнена в сказочном аниме-стиле с высочайшим уровнем детализации, динамичной сменой времени суток и реалистичными погодными условиями, создающими невероятно атмосферную картинку. Особого упоминания заслуживает музыкальное сопровождение, созданное внутренней студией HOYO-MiX и записанное крупнейшими мировыми симфоническими оркестрами. Музыка в игре глубоко отражает культурные особенности каждого региона благодаря гармоничному сочетанию классических симфонических инструментов и аутентичных народных мотивов разных стран мира. Игра распространяется по бесплатной модели Free-to-Play и получает масштабные контентные обновления каждые шесть недель, которые постоянно добавляют новые территории, персонажей, сюжетные главы и временные события.

d: Поплачьте Roblox — это не просто игра, а целая онлайн-платформа, где пользователи могут и играть в проекты других людей, и сами создавать свои собственные миры. Иногда её даже называют метавселенной. Я подобрала главное, чтобы вам было проще разобраться. Суть в том, что Roblox даёт инструменты, а весь уникальный контент создают сами игроки. Каждый отдельный игровой мир внутри платформы называется «плейс» (Place). Кто-то строит симулятор жизни, кто-то — полосу препятствий (обби), ролевую игру, хоррор или экономический симулятор (тайкун). Чтобы создавать свои игры, есть отдельная бесплатная программа — Roblox Studio. В ней есть визуальный редактор: можно собирать локации из готовых блоков, как из LEGO, а если захочется добавить сложную механику (движение, взаимодействие), можно писать код на языке Luau (это диалект более популярного Lua). При этом для простых идей часто достаточно просто собрать мир из готовых элементов, не углубляясь в программирование. #мм2 #роблокс #игры #плейсы #fyp
zh: 哭吧——Roblox不只是一款游戏，而是一整个在线平台，用户既可以游玩他人创作的内容，也可以自己

d: ayangin lagi lihat ke arah laut, tiba-tiba ada gumpalan hitam misterius melayang sendirian di langit. Itulah pemandangan yang direkam seorang pria di Sydney, Australia. Dalam videonya terlihat sebuah massa berwarna gelap menggantung di udara, terpisah dari awan-awan lain di sekitarnya. Bentuknya begitu aneh sampai orang yang merekam mengatakan kalau benda itu terlihat seperti logam cair, dan ia yakin itu bukan awan biasa. Nggak butuh waktu lama, videonya langsung viral dan memancing ribuan komentar. Banyak orang mencoba menebak apa sebenarnya yang mereka lihat. Ada yang yakin itu adalah UFO. Ada yang mengira hanya polusi udara. Bahkan, tidak sedikit yang mengatakan bentuknya sangat mirip Dementor, makhluk gelap yang melayang di udara dalam serial Harry Potter. Namun setelah diamati lebih lanjut, banyak pengamat percaya bahwa fenomena tersebut kemungkinan besar hanyalah scud cloud, yaitu jenis awan rendah yang biasanya terpisah dari kumpulan awan utama. Bentuknya memang tidak beraturan dan sering terlihat gelap, sehingga mudah membuat siapa pun mengira sedang melihat sesuatu yang misterius. Kalau kamu sendiri melihat pemandangan seperti ini secara langsung, kira-kira pikiran pertama yang muncul apa? Fenomena alam... atau sesuatu yang belum bisa dijelaskan? d: Analog horror is a subgenre of horror fiction commonly characterized by low-fidelity graphics, cryptic messages, few to no traditional jump scares, and visual styles reminiscent of late 20th-century television and analog recordings.[3][4][5][6] It is an offshoot of the found footage film genre,[7][3][8] said to have its origins in online horror of the late 2000s and early 2010s, including creepypasta stories[9] and found footage series such as No Through Road and Marble Hornets.[8][3][10][11] The genre gained more widespread popularity with the release of Kris Straub's Local 58 in October 2015, with the series' slogan ("ANALOG HORROR AT 476 MHz") providing the genre's name. #aesthetic #fyppppppppppppppppppppppp #xyzbca #analoghorror #rareaesthetic
zh: 模拟恐怖是恐怖小说的一个子流派，通常以低保真画质、神秘信息、极少或没有传统跳吓，以及令人联想到20世纪末电视和模拟录像风格为特征。它是伪纪录片电影类型的分支，据说起源于2000年代末至2010年代初的网络恐怖内容，包括都市怪谈故事和伪纪录片系列，如《No Through Road》和《Marble Hornets》。该类型随着Kris Straub的《Local 58》于2015年10月发布而获得更广泛的关注，该系列的口号"476 MHz的模拟恐怖"也由此为这一类型命名。

d: What if the world's most dangerous secret... has been hiding inside a book for over 600 years? The moment you open it... nothing makes sense. Every page is filled with a strange language... yet no nation... no civilization... and no point in history has ever used these symbols. Then you notice the illustrations. Hundreds of plants... painted in incredible detail. But there's one problem. Not a single one can be confidently identified on Earth. Some look like impossible combinations of different species. As if they were copied from a place no human has ever seen. Turn another page... and the mystery grows even darker. Strange star maps... unknown constellations... mysterious circular diagrams... and women floating inside bizarre green pools connected by impossible tubes. This mysterious book has a name. The Voynich Manuscript. What were they recording? Medicine? Alchemy? A lost civilization? Or knowledge that was never meant for us? For more than a century... the world's greatest cryptographers... historians... linguists... and now even artificial intelligence... have all tried to decode its message. Every one of them failed. The book follows the patterns of a real language... yet nobody can read a single sentence. Which leaves one terrifying possibility. What if this book isn't describing our world at all? If these plants don't grow on Earth... if these stars don't belong to our sky... then where did its author get this knowledge? More than 600 years later... the Voynich Manuscript is still waiting for someone... who can finally read it. #voynichmanuscript #mystery #darkhistory #unsolvedmystery #secret
zh: 如果世界上最危险的秘密……已在一本书中藏匿了六百余年？一旦翻开，一切都令人费解。每一页都写满奇异文字，却没有任何国家、任何文明、任何历史时期曾使用过这些符号。书中绘有数百种植物，细节精美，却无一能被确认为地球上真实存在的物种，有些像是不同物种的奇异组合，仿佛临摹自人类从未踏足之地。再翻一页，谜团愈发深沉——奇怪的星图、未知星座、神秘圆形图表，以及浸泡在绿色水池中、由奇异管道相连的女性形象。这本神秘的书有一个名字：伏尼契手稿。它记录的究竟是什么？医学？炼金术？失落的文明？还是本不该属于我们的知识？一个多世纪以来，世界上最顶尖的密码学家、历史学家、语言学家，乃至人工智能，都曾尝试破译它，无一成功。这本书符合真实语言的规律，却没有人能读懂哪怕一句话。这让人不禁产生一个令人不寒而栗的念头：如果这本书描述的根本不是我们的世界呢？如果这些植物不生长于地球，这些星辰不属于我们的天空，那么它的作者究竟从何处获得这些知识？六百多年过去了，伏尼契手稿依然在等待那个……终能读懂它的人。

Reyna applied a traditional coconut oil preparation reported in regional documentation to have protective properties against Aswang contact. The beast retreated shortly after the oil was administered. #aswang #philippines #folklore #cryptid #paranormal

d: Lagu Multo dari Cup of Joe punya arti yang cukup mendalam. --- Makna Lagu Multo 1. “Multo” = “Hantu” Kata multo dalam bahasa Filipino berarti hantu.  Dalam lagu ini, “hantu” bukanlah hantu harfiah, tapi metafora untuk sesuatu/​seseorang dari masa lalu yang terus menghantui perasaan.  2. Kenangan yang Tak Terlupakan Lagu menggambarkan kesulitan untuk melupakan seseorang atau masa lalu, walaupun sudah berusaha move on. Kenangan muncul terus, seperti “hantu” yang tak kunjung hilang.  3. Perasaan Bersalah, Duka, dan Refleksi Diri Liriknya menyiratkan bahwa orang yang bercerita dalam lagu masih menghadap rasa sakit emosional, penyesalan, atau mungkin kehilangan yang belum bisa diterima sepenuhnya. Ada unsur refleksi, mencoba mengerti kenapa kenangan tersebut tetap ada.  4. Peralihan Emosional dan Musik Lagu ini juga dapat dilihat sebagai pergeseran musik untuk bandnya (Cup of Joe) — dari tema yang lebih ringan ke hal yang lebih introspektif dan emosional. Memakai “multo” sebagai simbol dari konflik batin dan perubahan dalam identitas emosional mereka.  --- Kalau kamu mau, aku bisa kasih terjemahan liriknya ke bahasa Indonesia juga supaya maknanya makin jelas — kamu mau? #multo #musik #anime #kaoru
zh: Cup of Joe的歌曲《Multo》有着相当深刻的含义。歌曲含义：1."Multo"意为"鬼魂"，在菲律宾语中是鬼的意思，歌中并非指字面上的鬼，而是比喻过去某人或某事持续萦绕心头的感受。2.无法忘怀的回忆：歌曲描述了难以忘记某人或某段过去的困境，即使努力释怀，回忆仍像"鬼魂"般挥之不去。3.愧疚、悲伤与自我反思：歌词暗示叙述者仍在面对情感上的痛苦、遗憾或尚未完全接受的失去，并试图理解那些回忆为何始终存在。4.情感与音乐的转变：这首歌也可视为乐队（Cup of Joe）音乐风格的转变，从较为轻松的主题走向更内省、更情感化的方向，以"鬼魂"象征内心冲突与情感认同的变化。如果你需要，我也可以提供歌词的中文翻译，让含义更加清晰，你有兴趣吗？

d: Martyrs (2008) is a French horror film that blends various subgenres, including psychological horror, revenge, and extreme violence. The film follows two young women, Lucie and Anna, who are deeply affected by traumatic events in their past. Lucie is haunted by visions of a creature from her childhood, and as the film progresses, the true horrors of her past unfold. The story shifts dramatically from a revenge tale to something much darker as the women uncover an underground organization involved in creating "martyrs"—people who are tortured to the point of transcending fear and witnessing the afterlife before death. This disturbing, twisted narrative builds to an intense and enigmatic conclusion that has left viewers theorizing about its meaning ever since. With a chilling atmosphere, unexpected turns, and shocking gore, Martyrs is considered one of the most impactful and debated horror films of its time. #fyp #filmtok #cinema #cinephile #fyp #foryoupage #horror #horrormovie #movierecommendations #filmlist #movierecommendation

d: The viral “Chloe, we’re going to Disneyland” clip didn’t feel like it was trying to go viral — and that’s exactly why it did. During a surprise family announcement, one sister instantly exploded with excitement, while Chloe’s reaction was the complete opposite: stunned, overwhelmed, and giving that now-iconic side-eye that said, “Wait… what?” That split-second expression turned into one of the internet’s most recognizable reaction memes of the 2010s. It wasn’t scripted or polished — just a raw childhood moment caught on camera. And somehow, that honesty made it timeless. A simple surprise became digital history. #internetculture #memehistory #2010s #viral #popculture
zh: 那段爆红的"Chloe，我们要去迪士尼乐园了"视频，当初看起来根本没想着要走红——这恰恰是它走红的原因。在一次家庭惊喜宣布中，其中一个姐妹立刻兴奋爆发，而Chloe的反应却截然相反：震惊、不知所措，还带着那个如今已成经典的斜眼表情，仿佛在说"等等……什么？"那一瞬间的表情成为2010年代互联网上最具辨识度的反应梗之一。它没有剧本，也没有精心设计，只是一个被镜头捕捉到的真实童年瞬间。而正是这份真实，让它经久不衰。一个简单的惊喜，就此成为互联网历史。

Did you catch this massive English subtitle fail in Duang with You?! 🛑🇹🇭 In this scene, the art professor catches the boys slacking off, and the subtitles translate his scolding as "Jeez. Assholes." But a real professor would be fired immediately for saying that in a classroom! The actual Thai word he mutters is "dek wane" (เด็กเวร). While it is definitely a reprimand, it translates much closer to a general term for "delinquents," "troublemakers," or "little rascals." Tone is so hard to capture in translation! 😂 What is the craziest BL translation fail you've ever seen? Let me know below! 👇 #DuangWithYou #TeeteePor #LearnThai #ThaiLanguage #ThaiDrama

d: cahsio khas bagan siapi api masak di kuali aja tapi hasilnya gak kalah jauh dengan yg macam di panggang.  utk campuran wantan mie bahan marinasi  1 kg daging 🐖 bagian as ( yolaibak)  5 siung bawang putih haluskan 2sdkm ang kak 2sdkm gula pasir 1sdkm kaldu jamur 1/2sdkm garam merica 2 sampai 3 tetes pewarna makan yg warna merah cabe supaya hasilnya lebih cantik.  bahan lainnya: 3siung bawang putih haluskan 1 liter air ( klu kalian masak banyak air boleh di tambah lagi ya)  4 sdkm gula pasir ( bila kurang manis boleh di tambahkan karena kuahnya kita buat racikan mie jadi mesti harus manis)  cara: daging di potong memangjang cuci hingga bersih lalu tiriskan, pindah ke baskom tuang semua daging lalu semua bahan di atas di campur kedalam daging lalu di aduk hingga rata tutup biarkan satu malam.  setelah satu malam keluarkan daging dari kulkas sisihkan.  siapkan kuali masukkan sedikit minyak( klu ada minyak babi wajib pakai biar lebih harum) tumis bawang putih hingga harum lalu tuang semua daging yg sudah di marinasi aduk" tutup masak dengan api sedang daging bisa mengeluarkan air jadi jangan lgsg masukkan air dulu ya. sesekali boleh di bolak balek bila air sudah mulai nyusut baru tambahkan air masak kembali lagi bila mendidih boleh tambahkan gula, kaldu jamur dan sedikit garam masak sampai daging empek angkat sisihkan dulu.  sisa air kaldu cahsio kita masak kembali tambahkan gula sampai terasa manis( karena kuah kaldunya utk racikan  ke wantan mie, jadi mesti lebih manis yg kita rasakan) masak sampai mendidih baru tuang ke wadah  sisakan sedikit kuah nya di kuali baru tuang cahsio masak kembali b lagi dengan api besar masuk sedikit aja gula aduk terus sampai cahsio kelihatan seperti di panggang gitu ya sampai mengkilat.  kalian bisa lihat vidio saya sampai habis.  setelah kering baru di angkat, cahsio siap di campur ke wantan mie, gak hanya campur ke wantan mie aja  bisa campur ke nasi grg kalipeng dan lain"  selamat mencoba semoga kalian  cocok 😊🥰

d: Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.

d: Mom’s Indonesian Beef Rendang 🇲🇨   What I grew up eating for over 17 years back in my hometown, Indonesia🇲🇨😍. Today, I share this recipe with you, in honor of Indonesia's Independence Day. Happy Independence Day Indonesia, Indonesia MERDEKA! 🇮🇩✨ Ingredients A: 1.4kg of beef, topside or silverside, diced into 4cm chunks 800ml of regular coconut cream 400ml of coconut milk 1 tbsp of chicken powder 1 tbsp of Sugar 2 tsp of salt 2 tbsp of coconut sugar 6 tbsp of vegetable oil for stir fry  Ingredients B, to blend: 15 cloves of garlic  3 medium onions or 250g, chopped 30g of ginger,, cut into small pieces  30g of turmeric, cut into small pieces 6 candlenuts 30g of galangal, cut into small pieces 4 stalks lemongrass, chopped 6 tbsp of vegetable oil, to blend Ingredients C: 5 bay leaves 8 kaffir lime leaves 4 lemongrass, chopped 8 cloves wholes 3 cinnamon sticks 4 cardamoms 4 star anises Seasoning: 2 tsp of cilantro ground 2 tsp of turmeric ground 2 tsp of white pepper 2 tsp of cinnamon powder Steps: 1. Cut the beef into 4cm chunks and do not cut the beef into smaller pieces as they will break down during the cooking. 2. Add all of the Ingredients B in a blender or food processor. Then, blend it or give it a blitz until all the become a thick paste. Set aside 3. In the heavily-bottomed pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. 4. Then, pour the paste (from Ingredients B) into the pan and cook the paste until fragrant for 2 minutes. 5. Add the “Ingredients C” to the pan and stir to mix. 6. Next, add the “Seasoning” and followed by chicken powder, sugar and salt to the pan. Cook the paste until fragrant ( the paste will change color to red-brown ish ) 7. Add the beef to the pan and cook the beef until it is lightly browned.  8. Add coconut milk into the pan and stir to combine. Then, add coconut cream and bring it to simmer. 9. Cover and simmer in low heat for 1 hour until the beef is tender and the sauce thickens. (Stir it periodically to prevent the meat from burning) 10. Once the sauce has thickened and released reddish oil, add coconut sugar and give it a final mix. 11. Cover and simmer for another 30 minutes until it turns into dark brown. 12. Once it is done, enjoy with a bowl of rice! Notes: You should let the meat sit overnight for the flavors to be fully absorbed in the meat #indonesianfood #beefrendang #dinnerideas #easyrecipes

d: 🍗 Ayam tuh potensinya banyak! Jangan digoreng terussss ❌🙅‍♂️ Jangan sampe potensi ayam sia-sia! Sekali-sekali, coba deh kalo punya ayam dibikin jadi ayam palekko khas Bugis gini.. Pedas, gurih, medoknya pasti sukses ngabisin beras 3 karung 😅🤣 emang deh, masakan Indonesia ga ada matinya! AYAM PALEKKO Bahan 1: • 500 Gr Ayam (potong 20 bagian) • 1 SDT Desaku kunyit bubuk • 1 ½ SDT Garam • 1 SDM Air Bahan 2: (blender/haluskan) • 6 Buah Bawang Merah • 3 Buah Kemiri (goreng) • 3 Cm Jahe • 3 Cm Lengkuas • 1 SDM Desaku cabe bubuk • 1 Batang Serai (ambil 10 cm bagian putihnya saja dan rajang • 3 SDM Air Bahan 3: • 5 SDM Minyak Goreng (untuk menumis) • 3 Lembar Daun Jeruk • 2 Lembar Daun Salam Bahan 4: • 250 ml Air • 2 Kelereng Asam Jawa (rendam dengan 3 sdm air panas, ambil airnya) • 2 SDT Desaku bawang putih bubuk • ½ SDT Ladaku merica bubuk • 1 SDT Gula Cara Memasak: 1. Campurkan semua Bahan 1 ke dalam kontainer. Kocok hingga tercampur rata. Diamkan selama 30 menit. 2. Blender Bahan 2, sampai halus. 3. Panaskan 5 sendok makan Minyak, tumis bumbu yang sudah diblender (Bahan 2) sampai naik minyak. 4. Tambahkan Daun Jeruk dan Daun Salam, tumis sampai mengeluarkan aroma. 5. Masukkan ayam, tumis sampai ayam berubah warna. 6. Masukkan Bahan 4, masak sampai mendidih. 7. Kecilkan api dan masak selama 10 menit dengan wajan tertutup. 8. Lanjutkan memasak dengan wajan terbuka sampai mulai berminyak dan kekentalan kuah yang diinginkan 9. Angkat dan hidangkan. #makassar #masakanrumahan #indonesianfood

Opor Ayam ✅  Kalo mau lebaran kalian udah pasti siap” buat bikin opor kan? Jangan lupa ya bikinnya pake Sasa Santan yang santannya lebih stabil dan tidak mudah pecah walaupun dimasak lama jd bikin rasa lebih konsisten. Bahan : •⁠  ⁠1 ekor ayam kampung •⁠  ⁠2 liter air •⁠  ⁠2 bungkus sasa santan 65ml •⁠  ⁠1 sdt garam •⁠  ⁠2 sdm bawang goreng  Bahan bumbu halus •⁠  ⁠10 siung bawang putih •⁠  ⁠12 buah bawang merah •⁠  ⁠3 buah kemiri •⁠  ⁠½ sdt jinten •⁠  ⁠2 sdt ketumbar  •⁠  ⁠2 sdm minyak kelapa Bahan aromatic •⁠  ⁠6 buah bawang merah (iris) •⁠  ⁠1 batang sereh (geprek) •⁠  ⁠2 lembar daun salam •⁠  ⁠2 lembar daun jeruk •⁠  ⁠1 ruas lengkuas Cara membuat 1.⁠ ⁠Blender halus bumbu halus. 2.⁠ ⁠Tumis bawang merah hingga wangi. Tambahkan bumbu halus. Tumis hingga tidak langu. 3.⁠ ⁠Tambahkan bahan aromatic, tumis hingga wangi. 4.⁠ ⁠Tambahkan air sedikit air. Aduk rata. 5.⁠ ⁠Lalu masukkan ayam, air dan garam. Masak hingga matang. 6.⁠ ⁠Tambahkan santan. Aduk rata. 7.⁠ ⁠Tambahkan bawang goreng. 8.⁠ ⁠Siap disajikan. . Resep Warabi Mochi (untuk 4-6 porsi) Bahan adonan: 70 gr tapioka 1 ½ sdm bubuk jeli polos 4 sdm gula pasir (boleh ditambah sesuai selera) 500 ml air Bahan lainnya: kinako sirup gula merah Cara membuat: 1. Siapkan panci, masukkan tapioka, bubuk jeli polos, gula pasir dan air lalu aduk hingga semua bahan tercampur rata 2. Masak dengan api sedang kecil sambil terus diaduk menggunakan balloon whisk hingga adonan mengental dan bening 3. Tuangkan adonan ke dalam cetakan, kemudian hentakkan cetakan. Tunggu hingga adonan dingin dan set selama 30 menit-1 jam, kemudian masukkan ke dalam kulkas 4. Keluarkan warabi mochi dari cetakan ke atas plastik yang telah ditaburi kinako, lalu balurkan hingga seluruh permukaannya tertutup rata 5. Potong warabi mochi sesuai selera, lalu sajikan dengan sirup gula merah 6. Warabi Mochi siap disajikan

d: Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. It doesn’t need to be cooked through. Remove and set aside. 5. In the same pot, add the diced jalapeño and red onion. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. 6. Stir in the sun-dried tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds. 7. Add the Loisa Sofrito and minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 8. Pour in the chicken stock and tomato sauce, stirring to combine. Bring to a gentle boil. 9. Return the chicken to the pot. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the chicken is fall-apart tender and the sauce has reduced. 10. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, add the halved potatoes and diced zucchini. Continue simmering until the potatoes are fork-tender and the zucchini is cooked. 11. Serve over fluffy white rice and spoon plenty of the sauce over the top. #chickenlegs #braised #onepotmeals #cookwithme

"หมึกต้มกะทิ" เมนูไทยโบราณที่หอมละมุน! 🦑🥥 กะทิเคี่ยวกับกะปิหอมๆ เข้ากับหน่อไม้กรุบกรอบและหมึกสดเด้ง ตัดรสด้วยชะอมและพริกขี้หนูเผ็ดนิดๆ คือที่สุดของความนัว กินกับข้าวสวยร้อนๆ คือฟินมากครับ! วัตถุดิบ หมึกกล้วย   500 กรัม กะทิ     2 ½  ถ้วย ตะไคร้บุบ    2 ต้น หอมเเดงบุบ    8 หัว กะปิ     1 ½  ช้อนชา หน่อไม้จืดต้มหั่นเเท่ง   200 กรัม น้ำปลา    3 ช้อนโต๊ะ น้ำตาลมะพร้าว   1 ช้อนโต๊ะ ชะอม     1 ถ้วย พริกขี้หนูเขียวเเดงบุบ   2 ช้อนโต๊ะ วิธีทำ 1. ล้างปลาหมึกให้สะอาด ดึงเเกนกลาง กรีดเอาตาออก เเละหั่นปลาหมึกเป็นชิ้นหนา 1-2 นิ้ว เตรียมไว้ 2. ใส่กะทิลงในหม้อ ยกตั้งบนไฟกลาง ตามด้วยตะไคร้ หอมเเดงเเละกะปิ ต้มให้พอหอม ใส่หน่อไม้จืด ต้มให้เข้ากัน ใส่ปลาหมึก ปรุงรสด้วยน้ำปลาเเละน้ำตาลมะพร้าว คนให้เข้ากัน ใส่ชะอมเเละพริกขี้หนู คนพอเข้ากัน พอเดือด ปิดไฟ 3. ตักปลาหมึกต้มกะทิใส่ชาม #หมึกต้มกะทิ #เมนูอาหารไทย #แจกสูตรอาหาร #กับข้าวบ้านๆ #เมนูจากปลาหมึก

d: PAD KEE MAO 🇹🇭 AKA Drunken Noodles Make sure you adjust the flavors to your taste. More Fish sauce and light soy sauce if it isn’t salty enough. Dark soy sauce is mainly for the color. Oyster sauce for some sweetness and umami.  Ingredients: 10oz fresh rice noodles 2-3 chicken thighs  Thai chilis to preferred spice  5-10 cloves garlic Handful of Thai basil or holy basil if you can find it Green onions  1/2 a Bell pepper 1/4 Onion Sauce: 1tbsp oyster sauce 2 tbsp fish sauce 1 tbsp light soy sauce 1tbsp dark soy sauce 2 tsp white pepper 1tbsp palm sugar MSG optional  1. Slice chicken thighs into cubes then marinate for a couple minutes with dark soy sauce and white pepper. 2. Pound or mince garlic and thai chilis together to make a paste 3. Cook your chicken all the way through then set aside 4. Add more oil to the same pan then sauté your chili garlic paste until fragrant.  5. Add your sliced onions, bell pepper, and green onion and toss together to sweat the onions 6. Add your chicken back in then add your noodles 7. Now add your sauce, you can prepare it before hand or add it directly to the pan.  8. Mix well and try not to break the noodles 9. Turn off the heat and add your thai basil in and toss together  10. Enjoy #thaifood #padkeemao #noodles

d: レシピ👇 　　　仕込み10分！ あとはオーブンおまかせ🍳 　＼海外でバズってる！／ 🥩パリパリミートロール 今海外で話題のレシピを お家でも簡単に作れる様に アレンジしてみたよ〜😊 多めに作って、冷凍ストックもできる！ 冷凍したら、出してオーブンで焼くだけ☺️ 毎日頑張ってるママに オーブン料理の“手軽さ”を届けたい🍳 予熱の間に仕込めて オーブンに入れたら、 あとは火加減不要だから 焦げや煮詰めすぎの心配無し🙂‍↕️ 待ってる間は洗い物したり お洗濯したり、 ちょっとひと息タイムしたり☕️🫶 ✔ 洗い物ほぼ無し ✔ 食べムラっ子爆食い👧🏻👦🏻 ✔️油はねヤケドの心配なし ——— ⚫︎パリパリミートロール 【材料】予熱210度に熱しておく ○豚ミンチ　　　　　500g  (お好みで合挽きでもOK) ○キャベツ　　　　　1/4個 ○玉ねぎ　　　　　中1/2個 ○ジャガイモ　　　2〜3個 ★牛乳　　　　　　　大1.5 ★塩　　　　　　　　小1.5 ★胡椒　　　　　　　少々 ★マヨネーズ　　　　大1  ★ニンニク　　　　　1カケ ★粉チーズ　　　　　大1.5 (チューブの場合　2〜3cm) 　お好みで飾りパセリ🌿 ◎はるまきの皮　　１袋(10枚) ◎油(皮に塗る用)       少量 ◎油(かける用)　　　適量 　 《タレ》 ●オーロラソースがオススメ！ ケチャップ2:マヨネーズ1   ⇨混ぜる🙌 他には、おろしポン酢も美味しいよ😋 【作り方】 ①キャベツ、玉ねぎをスライスする (お好みで細みじん切りでもOK) ②お肉と★を入れよく混ぜ 　5等分にする ③ジャガイモを1.5〜2cm厚に切る 　はるまきの皮を2枚ごとにはがす ④ 天板にクッキングシートを敷き    皮に"②"のお肉を広げる。 　皮後半2割くらい残し、 　その部分に油を指で少量塗る ✅お肉は横はみ出るくらいに広げる 　(スカスカにならない様に) 　切った後に形を整えます🙌 ⑤ミートロールを丸める 　なるべく空気が入らない様に 　少し力を加えながら 　巻き終わりの部分は下にして 　皮同士がくっつく様にする ⑥ミートロールを切る 　(5等分がおすすめ) ⑦油を全体にうすくかける ⑧210度のオーブン下段25分焼く 　⇨完成🙌 火加減いらずのほったらかし🍳 「これなら作れそう！」と思ったら 忘れないように保存してね📌 #海外バズレシピ #オーブン #シンママ #はるまきの皮

d: Where taxi drivers eat in Korea Jeyuk Bokkeum (Spicy Stir-Fried Pork) 🧡 Ingredients 500g thinly sliced pork shoulder 2 green onions 1/2 onion -for the sauce 1/2 tbsp gochujang 2 tbsp soy sauce 2 tbsp cooking wine (or mirin) 2 tbsp gochugaru 1 tbsp corn syrup 1 tbsp minced garlic 1/2 tbsp oyster sauce 1/2 tbsp sugar -for serving Cooked rice Lettuce and perilla leaves Sesame oil Sesame seeds 💙 Directions  1. In a small bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients. 2. Slice the onion and green onions. 3. Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium-high heat. Add the pork and cook until it's no longer pink. 4. Add the onion and green onions, then stir-fry until the onion has softened. 5. Pour in the sauce and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring frequently. 6. Finish with a drizzle of sesame oil and a sprinkle of sesame seeds. 7. Serve with rice, and wrap each bite in lettuce or perilla leaves. 🔖 Save this recipe for your next meal  🥰 Like, follow & comment if you enjoyed  .  .  . .  . . #koreanfood #easyrecipes #comfortfood #quickrecipe #jeyukbokkeum

d: Have you ever craved something you’ve never even had before? 😂 I randomly thought, what if I turned potatoes into boba? And let me tell you… they’re SO chewy and delicious!  Potato Boba Ingredients 3–4 russet potatoes 1 cup potato starch Salt, to taste For the chili oil topping 1 tsp gochugaru 1 tbsp chopped parsley or green onions 1 tbsp minced garlic 1 tbsp soy sauce 2–3 tbsp hot oil 1. Steam or boil the potatoes until fork tender (I steamed mine). 2. Mash them while they’re still hot. Add the potato starch and salt, then knead into a smooth dough. If it’s too dry, add a little water. 3. Roll the dough into small boba-sized balls. 4. Boil until they float to the surface, then transfer them to cold water. Drain well. 5. Place the potato boba in a bowl. Add the gochugaru, parsley or green onions, garlic, and soy sauce. 6. Pour the hot oil over everything and mix until well coated.
zh: 你有没有馋过一样从没吃过的东西？我突发奇想把土豆做成波霸，口感超 Q 弹好吃！土豆波霸食谱：土豆 3–4 个、土豆淀粉 1 杯、盐适量；辣油料：韩国辣椒粉 1 茶匙、香芹或葱末 1 汤匙、蒜末 1 汤匙、酱油 1 汤匙、热油 2–3 汤匙。蒸或煮软后趁热捣泥，加淀粉和盐揉成面团，搓成小球，煮至浮起后过冷水沥干，放入碗中加入所有调料，淋热油拌匀即可。

d: 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood
zh: 菲律宾猪肉阿斗波｜菲律宾美食圣经第1集。这是我对菲律宾经典菜肴猪肉阿斗波的演绎，本系列将收录菲律宾各式菜肴的多种做法，欢迎留言告诉我下期想看什么。食材：猪五花肉1.2千克、蒜15-20瓣（切末）、洋葱1个（切碎）、猪骨汤500毫升、酱油190毫升、甘蔗醋100毫升、长青辣椒3根、月桂叶4片、整粒黑胡椒1汤匙、椰糖30克、食用油适量；配料：葱丝、香脆蒜末、水煮蛋。做法：将猪肉煎至四面微黄后取出备用；原锅爆香蒜末至金黄，加入洋葱炒软；放回猪肉，倒入猪骨汤、酱油、醋、青辣椒、月桂叶、胡椒和椰糖；加盖中火焖5-10分钟（不要搅拌，让醋充分挥发）；转小火慢炖1-2小时至肉质软烂、汤汁收浓；可在出锅前2-3分钟放入溏心蛋；配热米饭，撒上香脆蒜末和葱丝，搭配水煮蛋享用。

d: 🇵🇭 Ngohiong | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 13 Cebuano ngohiong coming from Filipino Chinese influence -  is essentially a battered deep fried spring roll, filled with seasoned meat, vegetables, and the distinct aroma of five-spice.  But  what even makes it better is  its thick, sweet, savory, and spicy dipping sauce. *most measurements are estimates. Season and adjust to your liking :) INGREDIENTS: Wrapping: - Lumpia wrappers as needed Filling: - ½ kilogram of ground pork - 5 cups heart of palm/ubod, julienned - 1 white onion, sliced - 15-20 cloves of garlic, minced - Green Onion/Leeks - 1 tsp 5 spice powder - ¼ cup soy sauce - ¼ cup sugar - 2 tbsp of oyster sauce - 1 tsp of white pepper - 1 stalk of spring onions, sliced Dipping batter: - 1 1/2 cup flour - 1/2 cup cornstarch - 2 cups water - 1 tsp five spice powder - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper - annatto for color  - 2 tbsp oil Ngohiong sauce: - 250g of potato - red chili to taste (labuyo) - 1 carrot, chopped - 15-20 cloves of garlic, sliced - 1 cup of vinegar - 1 tbsp of fish sauce - 1 cup of sugar - Annatto for color - 2 cups of Water INSTRUCTIONS:  - Saute garlic and onions in a pan. Add all the ingredients under “Filling,” then cook until the pork is fully cooked and everything is well combined. - Place filling near the bottom of each lumpia wrapper. Brush the top edge with a flour-and-water mixture, then roll tightly and seal. Set aside. - To make the dipping batter, combine all the ingredients under “Dipping Batter”. Dip each into the batter, then fry at 165°C for 4–5 minutes, or until golden and crisp. - For the ngohiong sauce, add all the ingredients under “Ngohiong Sauce” to a pot. boil until the carrots and potatoes are soft, then blend until smooth. - Serve the ngohiong hot and crispy with a generous amount of sauce, and enjoy! #cookingasmr #asmr #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood

🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

d: 🇵🇭🍗 Max’s Style Fried Chicken INGREDIENTS: *some measurements may be estimates only so season and adjust to your liking 🙏🫶 Chicken Marinade: - 6pcs chicken leg quarter - 1/4 cup patis - 1/4 cup ml of calamansi - 10 cloves of garlic, minced Chicken blanching liquid: - 3 onions, chopped - 3 heads garlic, halved - 1 stalk of cilantro/wansoy - ¼ cup of calamansi juice - 3-4 bay leaves  - ¼ cup of peppercorn - ¼ cup of patis - 1-2 sachets of Maggi Magic Sarap - marinating liquid - Water as needed Chicken Drying: - 1 sachet of Maggi Magic Sarap - 1 tsp of baking powder Chicken Frying: - Oil as needed Sweet Potato Fries: - 6 sweet potatoes, fries cut - Water as needed - ⅓ cup of white vinegar - 1/4 cup of flour - ¼ cup of cornstarch - ¼ cup of rice flour - 1 tsp of baking powder - 1 tsp of baking soda - Water from soaking - Oil Dipping: - Banana Ketchup - Worcestershire sauce INSTRUCTIONS - Marinate the chicken w/ all ingredients under “marinade”. Set aside for 2hrs-overnight. - Transfer the chicken to a pot and add all the ingredients under “Chicken Boiling Liquid.” Pour in enough water to cover most of the chicken, low simmer for around 15 mins. - Combine the Maggi Magic Sarap and baking powder, then season the chicken evenly. dry in fridge overnight uncovered. - Soak sweet potatoes in water and vinegar. Reserve some soaking water before draining. Combine the potatoes, flour, cornstarch, rice flour, baking powder, and baking soda. add a little reserved soaking liquid to create a light batter. deep fry at 165°C for 4-5mins or until crisp. - For the dipping sauce, combine the banana ketchup and Worcestershire sauce. - Serve fried chicken with rice, sweet potato fries, and dipping sauce. Enjoy! #CookwithMagic #cookingasmr #asmr

🇵🇭 Ilocos Empanada | Filipino Food Bible Episode 4 A crispy pocket of goodness filled with sausage, egg and papaya originating from Ilocos in the northern region of the Philippines. Many variations exist but this is my take inspired by both the Vigan and Batac versions! note: adjust ratios of water/flour depending on flour brand since absorption rates may vary. Measurements are weighed but adjust to your preference! INGREDIENTS: Vigan Longganisa/sausage: - 1kg ground pork - 170g of garlic, minced - 80 ml spiced cane vinegar - 80 ml soy sauce - 2-3 tsp of ground black pepper - 1 tbsp of brown sugar - Salt to taste - pinch of MSG Spiced Vinegar: - 15-20 cloves garlic - 3 green chili - 9 birds eye chili - 15 shallots - 700 ml cane vinegar - 1 tbsp freshly cracked black pepper - 1 tsp salt - 30 ml fish sauce Dough (Yield 7-8 ~110g per ball): - 340g rice flour - 2 cups water - pinch of salt - 1 1/2 tbsp of chicken powder - 2 1/2 tbsp of annatto powder - 4 tbsp oil  Filling: - 2:1 ratio shredded green papaya to mung beans - salt/pepper to taste INSTRUCTIONS:  - for spiced vinegar blend together all ingredients under "spiced vinegar”. set aside - For the sausage, combine all ingredients listed under "Vigan longganisa” mix and let sir for 1hr - overnight  . Sear until rendered and crispy. - soak beans for about 1-2 hrs. Drain and boil for ~15mins until soft. - Shred papaya, add salt. squeeze water out. Combine w/ munggo and season w salt and pepper. - For the dough combine annatto powder, oil, salt, chicken powder and water. Boil and add to flour. knead until the texture resembles clay. you can combine w/ flour directly on stovetop. - roll ball of dough between cut plastic until thin - In the center place your papaya mixture and form a small hollow circle. add sausage, and egg at the center - Fold, tuck in the sides, and cut excess dough using a plate. Fry at 165C until crispy - Serve w/ spiced vinegar and enjoy! #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr

It has a bold, funky aroma that doesn't exactly whisper "eat me" but don't let the smell fool you. Much like blue cheese, anchovies or well-aged French cheese, some of the world's most beloved foods are a little intimidating before they become irresistible. d: Cajun butter steak bites over parmesan mashed potatoes🥩🧈 recipe below: Cajun butter🧈 -4 tbsp unsalted softened butter  -1/2 tsp seasoned Cajun -1 tsp parsley -2 tsp minced garlic  -1 tsp lemon juice -1/2 tsp Dijon mustard  Mix until combined (optional: add red pepper flakes for spice) Cajun steak bites🥩 -trim 2 steaks of choice into 1 inch pieces -season with 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 1 tsp buttery steakhouse seasoning -let steaks rest before cooking to avoid chewy steak bites ** -cook in avocado oil on med/high heat -flip after 1-2 minutes  -reduce heat and stir in 2 tbsp Cajun butter -toss steak bites 1 additional minute  -remove steak and add asparagus  -season asparagus with lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, pepper, & Parmesan  creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes🥔 -peel 2 large gold potatoes  -dice into 1 inch cubes  -boil in salted water -drain water and mash -stir in 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp sour cream, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, 1/2 tbsp butter, salt, pepper, & garlic powder  Assembly✨ -Add creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes to a bowl and top with Cajun butter steak bites🥩 Serve with asparagus, ciabatta, & garnish with parsley  #cooking #foodtiktok #fyp  #creatorsearchinsights #whatdoimakefordinner

d: KFC at Home Pt 1/3: The SECRET Fried Chicken Recipe… But Better 🍗 I choke slammed Colonel Sanders and stole his secret 11 herbs & spices recipe, then turned it into to one of the best fast food at home meals I’ve ever made 🤤  KFC Buffalo Ranch Recipe (upgraded) dropping soon if the Colonel doesn’t catch me first 🏃 👉 Full detailed recipes in bio 🔗 — CONDENSED RECIPE: KFC “Secret” 11 Herbs & Spices Mix together kosher salt, garlic powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, white pepper, thyme, oregano, mustard powder, ginger, basil, celery seed, and a little MSG (optional, but highly recommended). Reserve ⅓ for the marinade and ⅔ for the dredge. Chicken + Marinade Whisk together buttermilk, eggs, pickle juice, and ⅓ of the seasoning blend. Add chicken thighs + drumsticks, fully submerge, cover, and refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours). Double Dredge Combine flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and the remaining seasoning blend. Mix in a few spoonfuls of the marinade to create craggly bits. Remove the chicken from the marinade → dredge in the flour → back into the marinade → back into the flour (pressing and squeezing to fully coat) Fry Heat oil to 350°F. Fry until deeply golden brown and cooked to 165°F internal (thighs: 6–8 mins, drumsticks: 10–12 mins). Drain on a wire rack and hit with a little extra salt while they’re still hot. Serve Serve as-is or dip in my upgraded KFC Buffalo Ranch recipe DROPPING SOON 🔥 — #friedchicken #KFC #KFCcopycat #foodreels #chickenrecipe

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Steak & Eggs, cooked entirely in a cast iron pan on my balcony. There’s something about a hot cast iron, a ribeye, crispy potatoes, and eggs that just feels right. Ingredients: * 1 ribeye steak * Salt & black pepper * 3 Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into large chunks * 1 onion, julienned * 3 eggs * 1 tbsp neutral oil Cowboy Butter: * 1 stick (½ cup) butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, minced * 2 tbsp chopped parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes * ½ tsp Cajun seasoning * ½ tsp cayenne pepper * Salt & black pepper, to taste Method: 1. Preheat a cast iron pan in a 500°F pizza oven (or any very hot oven). Add the neutral oil and sear the ribeye until medium-rare to medium. Remove and let it rest. 2. Add the onion and cook until deeply golden. Stir in the potatoes and roast until they’re tender with crispy edges. 3. Push the potatoes to the outside of the pan, leaving a circle in the center. Crack in the 3 eggs. 4. Slice the rested steak. Pour in the cowboy butter, add the steak back to the pan, and let everything sizzle until the eggs are cooked to your liking. 5. Serve immediately and spoon that cowboy butter over everything. #steakandeggs #easyrecipes #ribeye #torontofood

Recipe Name Deep Dish Pepperoni Cheeseburger Pizza Pie Ingredients 1. 1 lb pizza dough 2. 1 lb ground beef 3. 1 cup pepperoni slices 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 1/2 green bell pepper, diced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 10. 1 cup pizza sauce 11. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 12. 1/2 tsp oregano 13. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 14. 1/2 tsp onion powder 15. 1/2 tsp salt 16. 1/2 tsp black pepper 17. 1 tbsp olive oil Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a deep cake pan or springform pan. 2. Press the pizza dough into the pan, covering the bottom and sides. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet and cook the onion, bell pepper, and garlic until softened. 4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess grease. 5. Stir in pizza sauce, Italian seasoning, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. 6. Spread half of the mozzarella over the crust. 7. Spoon the beef mixture evenly over the cheese. 8. Sprinkle the cheddar and Parmesan over the beef. 9. Arrange pepperoni slices on top and finish with the remaining mozzarella. 10. Bake for 35–40 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly. 11. Let the pie rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 12. Serve hot with extra pizza sauce if desired. Pull Apart Garlic Bread  Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tbsp sugar * 270g milk (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) * 380g flour (about 3 cups) * 1 tsp salt * 43g softened butter (about 3 tbsp) Butter Mixture * 100g butter, softened * 1 tbsp chopped cilantro * 1 garlic clove, minced * Shredded cheese Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the sugar and yeast. Add the milk, then add the flour and mix until combined. 2. Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated. 3. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled. 4. Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic. 5. Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over it. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. 6. Cut the dough in half, stack one half on top of the other, then cut into strips. Transfer the pieces into a loaf pan. 7. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 8. Bake at 370°F for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. Brush with the remaining garlic butter mixture while still warm. #bread #garlicbread #breadtok #baking #homemadebread

d: The easiest one-pan dinner you’ll ever make. Everything goes into one baking pan, the oven does all the work, and dinner practically makes itself. Tender beef, baby potatoes, onions, tomatoes, garlic, and jalapeños (or sweet peppers) roast low and slow in a rich, sweet-and-savory sauce with tomato paste, olive oil, date molasses, pomegranate molasses, and warm spices until the beef is fall-apart tender and every bite is packed with flavor. Ingredients✨ For the Pan • 2 lbs beef stew meat or chuck, cut into large cubes • 1½ lbs baby potatoes, halved • 2 large onions, cut into chunks • 3 to 4 tomatoes, roughly chopped • 1 to 2 jalapeños, sliced or substitute red and green bell peppers cut into chunks for a non spicy version • 12 to 15 garlic cloves, peeled For the Sauce • ⅓ cup tomato paste • ¼ cup olive oil • ¼ cup date molasses/maple syrup  • ⅛ cup pomegranate molasses/pomegranate juice  • 2 teaspoons paprika • 2 teaspoons salt • 1 teaspoon black pepper • About 2 cups water Instructions Bake in a 9 by 13 inch baking dish. Place the meat and all the vegetables into the pan just as shown in the video. In a separate measuring cup or bowl, prepare the sauce and pour it evenly over everything. Cover first with parchment paper, then seal tightly with foil. Bake in a preheated 375°F oven for 2 hours covered. Remove the cover and bake for an additional 30 minutes, then broil for about 10 minutes until beautifully browned. Serve with warm pita, bring it straight to the table just as is, and enjoy straight from the pan. Leftovers are even better the next day. #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepanmeal #meatandpotatoes #easydinnerideas

d: Here’s how to make The Ultimate Creamy Sausage Pasta 😍   Here’s the full recipe below 👇    200g mafaldine pasta (or your favourite shape) 4 pork sausages, skins removed 4 garlic cloves, minced 200ml chicken stock 100g mascarpone 60g grated Parmesan, plus extra to serve 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp dried thyme 10g parsley, chopped   1. Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente. Reserve a mug of the pasta water before draining. 2. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over a medium-high heat. Add the sausage meat, breaking it into small chunks with a wooden spoon. Leave it to brown well between stirring so you get plenty of crispy caramelised bits. Cook until golden. 3. Stir in the garlic and the dried thyme and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the chicken stock, scraping up all the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Simmer for 2 minutes. 5. Stir through the mascarpone, Parmesan, and Dijon mustard. Simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes until smooth and silky. Add the chopped parsley and stir well. 6. Add the cooked pasta and toss everything together until coated in the sauce. If needed, loosen with a splash of the reserved pasta water until glossy. 7. Finish with plenty of black pepper, and an extra grating of Parmesan before serving. The full recipe is also up on my website! Have a go, and let me know how you get on! ❤️

d: For 8 yuan ($1 USD) in China, I got a full kilogram of Jiang Xiang Bing  (酱香饼). The dough is flattened so wide that it folds onto itself while  baking, creating layers of texture. After five minutes in the oven, a  sweet fermented wheat sauce is brushed over the top. The folds soak up  the sauce, locking in extra flavor. Sesame seeds and scallions are  sprinkled as the finishing touch. The result is a fluffy, chewy bread  with a perfect balance of sweet and savory.   #China #Food #Travel #ChineseFood #ChinaFood #StreetFood
zh: 在中国花8元（约1美元）买了整整一公斤酱香饼。面团被擀得很薄，烘烤时层层叠叠，口感丰富。五分钟出炉后刷上甜味发酵麦酱，饼层吸饱酱汁，锁住香味，最后撒上芝麻和葱花。成品外松内韧，甜咸平衡恰到好处。

d: This ain’t your average mac and cheese🔥 Creamy gochujang mac & cheese topped with juicy steak and buttery shrimp, all made in a heart pan💓  The cream cheese makes it extra velvety, while the gochujang cuts through the richness with just the right amount of heat🔥 Creamy gochujang mac and cheese is my love language🍝✨Trust me—you’ll be obsessed after the first bite😍 📍Share with your pasta bestie & save this recipe for your next craving💗 ✨ Hailey’s Gochujang Cream Cheese Mac & Cheese 📝 Ingredients * 4oz elbow macaroni * 3 slices American cheese * 1 slice Colby Jack cheese * 2 tbsp cream cheese * ½–1 tbsp gochujang  * 1 cup heavy cream * 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese * ½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ¼ tsp paprika * ¼ tsp black pepper * Salt * Grilled shrimp * Sliced steak * Parsley ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1. Cook the macaroni until al dente. Reserve about ½ cup of the pasta water, then drain. 2. Over low heat, add the American cheese, Colby Jack cheese, cream cheese, and gochujang to a pan. Add the garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Stir until the cheeses are fully melted and the mixture is smooth. 3. Pour in the heavy cream and add the cooked macaroni. Stir until the pasta is evenly coated. 4. Add ½ cup of the shredded cheddar and ¼ cup of the mozzarella, stirring until melted and silky. If the sauce is too thick, loosen it with a splash of the reserved pasta water. 5. Sprinkle the remaining shredded cheddar and mozzarella over the top. Cover and cook for about 1 minute, or until the cheese is melted. 6. Top with grilled shrimp or sliced steak, then garnish with chopped parsley and freshly cracked black pepper. 💡 Tip * American cheese and cream cheese are the secret to an ultra-smooth, velvety sauce. * Start with ½ tablespoon of gochujang for a milder kick, or use 1 tablespoon if you like it spicier. * The gochujang balances the richness of the cheese, making every bite creamy without feeling too heavy. * Taste and adjust the salt at the end, since the cheese and gochujang already add plenty of seasoning. #asmrfood #mukbang #gochujangmacandcheese #koreanpasta #fyp

d: If you need an easy dinner recipe using a pound of ground beef, this Sloppy Joe Potato Skillet won’t disappoint!  INGREDIENTS  5 small/medium potatoes olive oil + salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika (for potatoes) 1 lb ground beef  1 chopped onion  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper  1 tsp onion powder and paprika  1 tbsp minced garlic  1-2 tbsp Worcestershire  8 oz can tomato sauce  1/4 cup ketchup  1 tbsp mustard  2 tbsp bbq sauce  1 1/2 cups shredded Colby Jack cheese  Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  Peel, wash, and cut potatoes up into cubes.  Toss them with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  Cook the potatoes in the air fryer at 400 degrees F for about 20-25 minutes shaking them around at least a couple of times while they cook.  Once the potatoes are cooking, brown the ground beef and onion in a skillet and add all seasonings.  Add minced garlic, Worcestershire, tomato sauce, ketchup, mustard, and bbq sauce. Let simmer on low until the potatoes are ready.  Add crispy potatoes to the skillet with the sloppy joe mix and give it a quick stir. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top and put in the oven under broil just to melt the cheese.  Enjoy! #easyrecipes #dinner #sloppyjoes

d: One bite, and you’ll never want to leave😈 Welcome back to “Single, but cooking like someone’s falling for me tonight.” Who’s hungry?👀  BURNT BASQUE TIRAMISU CHEESECAKE🤎 Cheesecake • 1.4kg cream cheese • 250g mascarpone • 350g caster sugar • 7 eggs • 600ml double cream • 30g plain flour • 20g cornflour • 2 tbsp espresso powder mixed with 40ml hot water • ½ tsp salt • 1 tbsp vanilla extract Topping • 500g mascarpone • 300ml double cream • 80g icing sugar • 2 tsp vanilla extract To Finish • Ladyfingers • Fresh hot espresso • Cocoa powder Method 1. Preheat the oven to 220°C. 2. Whisk together the cream cheese, mascarpone and sugar until smooth. 3. Mix in the eggs one at a time. 4. Add the double cream, vanilla, espresso, salt, plain flour and cornflour, then whisk until smooth. 5. Pour into a lined 10-inch cake tin. 6. Bake for 40-50 minutes until deeply caramelised on top with a slight wobble in the centre. 7. Leave to cool completely, then chill until cold. 8. Dip the ladyfingers briefly into hot espresso and arrange over the top of the cheesecake. 9. Whip together the mascarpone, double cream, icing sugar and vanilla until thick enough to pipe. 10. Pipe dollops over the ladyfingers and finish with a generous dusting of cocoa powder. #basque

d: Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

My highly requested vodka pasta recipe!! And yes this is enough for my family of 5 and leftovers! Also if you like spicy I reccomemd adding a bit of Calabrian chili paste it’s so good! Vodka pasta recipe: Approximate ingredients:(I don’t measure and I’m heavy handed) - half a large yellow onion(diced) - At least 3 cloves of minced garlic(preferably not jarred) - 2 tbsp olive oil - 1 can of tomato paste( 8 oz) - Salt and pepper to taste(as I go) - 1 tsp of red pepper flakes(or to preference depending on how spicy you like it) - 2 shots of vodka(ish) - 1 1/2 - 2 cups of heavy whipping cream(preheated) - Pasta water(to desired consistency) - Grated Parmesan cheese(to preference) - Fresh basil to top 1. On medium low heat add 2 tbsp of olive oil to a pan. Add in onions and cook for a few minutes until they’re translucent. Once translucent add in garlic and cook until garlic is slight brown but not burnt.  2. Add a little salt and pepper at this step or throughout.  3. Start to boil your pasta. Make sure you reserve some pasta water at some point.  4. Once garlic is slightly brown/tan, still on medium low heat, add in tomato paste and red pepper flakes and mix into the onions and garlic until combined.  5. Smooth paste over the pan and increase heat just barely(medium) and let cook until tomato paste deepens in color(a few minutes). 6. Once tomato paste deepens, turn heat back to medium low, and add in vodka and mix until combined. Careful it’s on lower heat so it dosent burn.  7. Add more salt and pepper to taste.  8. Slowly add in the preheated heavy whipping cream while mixing to combine.  9. Once combined add pasta water to reach desired consistency. The sauce will start to thicken as well once cooled down so keep that in mind during this step.  10. Grate in at least a half cup of Parmesan cheese, or more if you like parm.(please no pre grated cheese, it won’t melt) 11. Spoon the pasta into the sauce. I leave mine unstrained so the extra pasta water helps emulsify the sauce even more.  12. Plate pasta and top with some fresh basil, more grated parm and maybe some burrata and olive oil if you’re feeling extra! #italian #cookwithme #sundaydinner #vodkapasta #recipe

d: No-Dough Dumplings (4-Layer Flour Hack) No dough, no wrappers — just flour and meat. So satisfying & surprisingly delicious 🤍 #nodoughdumplings #dumplinghack #easyrecipes #foodtiktok #satisfyingfood No-Dough Dumplings Ingredients: * 1 lb ground beef (or pork) * 1 tsp salt * Black pepper * 1 onion (grated) * Fresh parsley (finely chopped) Instructions: 1. Mix ground meat with salt, pepper, grated onion, and parsley. 2. Shape into small balls. 3. Freeze for ~30 minutes to firm up. 4. Prepare a bowl of cold water and a tray of flour. 5. Dip each meatball in water → coat in flour. 6. Repeat this water + flour coating 4 times. 7. Lightly roll each ball in your hands to smooth the shape. 8. Boil in salted water for 6–8 minutes. 9. Serve with crispy garlic chili oil mixed with soy sauce and top with green onions.
